eps.ov: The war between the Kingdom and the Empire has been raging for decades. Hoping to end the carnage, Princess Fione enlists Harley and her team's help.
Taking on Ratcatcher's army of beasts turns out to be a piece of cake for the Suicide Squad.
Harley and the Suicide Squad triumphantly return from dragon-slaying when they find a blazing fortress and a heartbreaking defeat.
To stop the Suicide Squad from resetting their bombs, Thinker has his elf army build a fortress near the gate.
Back in the royal capital after their epic triumph, the Suicide Squad are in for a rude awakening.
The shocking truth about the Undead King is revealed! Princess Fione is devastated to learn the truth, but when Harley drops some truth bombs, it's game on!
Things look dire when Lich's undead army rolls in and starts wrecking the Kingdom.
